title: Layout with many objects
description: Code-style / performance rule — layouts with many objects (threshold adjustable via the header slider, default 250). Heavy layouts are slow to render and hard to maintain.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Hundreds of objects on one layout slow rendering and complicate edits.
rule.remediation: Split into multiple layouts / tab panels, or hide rarely-used parts.
